prompts:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: production background texture for the Tiefenhall main menu, not a UI mockup.
Input image: the attached complete cave-lake image is the EDIT TARGET.
Primary request: remove ONLY the stationary concentric droplet rings painted into the lake in the lower center-right. The most visible concentric oval rings are centered at approximately 69% of the image width and 77% of the image height, just to the left of the foreground wooden dock. Erase the entire concentric ring pattern and any other circular droplet ripple marks, replacing them seamlessly with the surrounding calm turquoise water, its natural straight horizontal surface texture and reflections, and visible underwater stones. There must be NO rings, circular waves, splash marks or water drops anywhere in the static lake texture, because the game generates these dynamically.
Strict invariants: keep the exact original full landscape composition, framing, aspect ratio, camera perspective and all object placements. Keep every cave rock, waterfall, mist, wooden bridge, dock, lantern, crystal, shore, foreground tool, crate and barrel exactly as in the source. Preserve existing painterly style, brightness, color palette, crispness, natural water reflections, and normal noncircular horizontal water texture. Do not change the entire water surface. Change only pixels needed to remove the circular ripple pattern. No added objects, UI, labels, text, crop, zoom, or redesign. Return the complete landscape image, not a close-up.

Use case: precise-object-edit. The input is the production cave lake background EDIT TARGET.
Make ONE surgical correction: remove the faint oval/concentric circular wave pattern that is STILL visible in the lower center-right turquoise water, centered near x=1150, y=725 in this 1672 by 941 image (69% from the left, 77% from the top), immediately left of the wooden dock. The whole ripple including its center and all surrounding oval ring contours must completely disappear.
Repaint ONLY the small water patch spanning approximately x=1000 to x=1300 and y=680 to y=780 with calm water matching the water directly above and to its left: straight horizontal thin uneven streaks, turquoise translucency, blue reflections and faint underwater texture. Do not retain, soften or recreate any ellipse, circle, concentric ring or splash within this patch. No circular wave shapes at all. Preserve the amber vertical lantern reflection to the left of this patch.
EVERYTHING else in the image must stay identical: exact composition, objects, cliffs, crystals, lanterns, dock, waterfalls, waterline, lighting, reflections outside this patch, foreground and fine painterly texture. Keep the same full-image framing and aspect ratio. No zoom, crop, text, UI or new objects. This is a calm static base plate for procedural animated droplets; no baked-in droplet ripples whatsoever.
requirement: Static lake contains no baked-in concentric droplet rings. Circular waves are created only by the runtime HomeCave shader.
